description: Call by name, no HS code needed: lists the named indicators this service computes from public customs statistics (for example the quarterly base price of domestic naphtha, naphtha import prices and origins, or Japan passenger car and parts exports by destination). Each entry has its id, aliases in English and Japanese, definition, how often it is published, the keys of its caveats (get_indicator gives their text), the latest month and whether it can be computed in this build (status ok, not_computable with a reason, or not_built). Use it first to find the id or alias to give to get_indicator; narrow the list with reporter or with words in query. The values are our own calculations, not official published figures.

query.description: Optional. Words that must all appear in the indicator id, alias (English or Japanese), title or definition, for example "naphtha" or "cars".

reporter.description: Optional. List only the indicators of this reporting country: "JP" or "GB". Omit for all deployed reporters.

name: list_indicators
